featured.title: Iran-US Crisis Escalates As Ceasefire Expires
featured.content: Tensions between Iran and the United States have intensified after diplomatic efforts stalled and the temporary ceasefire expired. Iran has announced a tougher military posture while Washington has ruled out extending the agreement. The Strait of Hormuz remains a major concern for global shipping and energy supplies. Brent crude rose above $91 a barrel as markets reacted to renewed supply fears.

articles.title: Iran Signals Tougher Military Posture
articles.description: Iran has signalled a shift toward a more offensive military posture after diplomatic efforts with the United States failed to produce a permanent agreement. The development has increased concerns about another escalation in the Middle East.

articles.title: Strait Of Hormuz Crisis Deepens
articles.description: The strategic Strait of Hormuz remains at the centre of the US-Iran confrontation. Reduced shipping through the waterway is raising concerns about oil supplies, international trade and global energy security.

articles.title: Oil Prices Jump Above $91
articles.description: Brent crude has risen above $91 a barrel as investors react to renewed fears of disruption to Middle Eastern energy supplies. A reported attack on a vessel exiting the Strait of Hormuz has added to market concerns.

articles.title: Ukraine War Remains A Major Security Concern
articles.description: Russia's military campaign against Ukraine continues, with strikes reported against Ukrainian infrastructure while Kyiv continues attacks against targets inside Russia. European governments remain focused on sanctions, security assistance and diplomacy.

articles.title: China Mourns Former Premier Zhu Rongji
articles.description: China is mourning former Premier Zhu Rongji, with national flags lowered at government buildings as the country holds funeral events under heightened security.

articles.title: South Korea Proposes Talks With North Korea
articles.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has proposed talks with North Korea aimed at replacing the Korean War armistice with a formal peace arrangement. The proposal comes as Washington adjusts the scale of joint military exercises with Seoul.

articles.title: Belgium's Major Wildfire Continues To Burn
articles.description: A massive wildfire in Belgium's High Fens nature reserve has burned around 3,000 hectares. Rain has provided some relief to firefighters, but the difficult terrain and dry conditions continue to make the operation challenging.

articles.title: Europe Continues Battling A Severe Wildfire Crisis
articles.description: Wildfires continue affecting parts of Europe, with Greece, Spain, Croatia, Portugal, France and Belgium among countries facing serious fire emergencies. Extreme heat and drought have created highly dangerous conditions.

articles.title: Extreme Weather Keeps Europe On Alert
articles.description: European governments continue monitoring extreme heat, drought and wildfire risks as emergency services remain under pressure during an exceptionally difficult summer fire season.

articles.title: US-Canada Trade Talks Intensify
articles.description: Washington and Ottawa are holding last-minute negotiations over proposed US tariffs on Canadian goods. The talks could have significant consequences for trade, businesses and consumers on both sides of the border.

articles.title: Osun Election: Adeleke Declared Winner
articles.description: Governor Ademola Adeleke has been declared the winner of the Osun State governorship election, securing another term after defeating APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji. The election is expected to remain a major political story in Nigeria.

articles.title: Nigeria's Inflation Falls To 15.43%
articles.description: Nigeria's headline inflation rate declined to 15.43% in July from 15.91% in June, according to figures released by the National Bureau of Statistics. The decline offers some relief, although food-price pressures remain important for households.

articles.title: Nigeria's Cost Of Living Remains A Major Concern
articles.description: Despite the decline in headline inflation, many Nigerian households continue facing pressure from food, transportation, housing and other essential costs.

articles.title: Nigeria's Fencing Team Makes History
articles.description: Nigeria's fencing team has received increased attention following a strong performance at the 2026 Commonwealth Fencing Championships in Lagos. Sports authorities have pledged greater support for the development of the sport.

articles.title: Nigeria And Meta Plan AI Academy
articles.description: Nigeria's Federal Government and Meta are reportedly planning an artificial intelligence academy aimed at strengthening technology skills, expanding access to AI education and developing Nigeria's digital talent.

articles.title: Africa Focuses On Technology And Economic Growth
articles.description: African governments and businesses continue investing in digital technology, artificial intelligence, infrastructure and entrepreneurship as they seek new opportunities for jobs and economic development.

articles.title: Global Markets Come Under Pressure
articles.description: Stocks and bonds are facing pressure as investors assess renewed US-Iran tensions, higher oil prices and the potential inflationary consequences of prolonged disruption to energy supplies.

articles.title: Oil Market Volatility Increases
articles.description: Energy markets remain highly volatile as traders assess the risk of further disruption around the Strait of Hormuz. Higher crude prices could increase transportation and production costs worldwide.

articles.title: Bond Yields Rise Amid Geopolitical Concerns
articles.description: Government bond yields have risen as investors assess the possibility that higher energy prices could increase inflation and complicate interest-rate decisions.

articles.title: Global Economy Watches Energy Security
articles.description: Businesses and governments are closely monitoring the Middle East crisis because prolonged disruption to major energy routes could affect inflation, trade, manufacturing and household costs.

articles.title: Nigeria And Meta Plan Artificial Intelligence Academy
articles.description: Nigeria's government and Meta are reportedly working toward an AI academy designed to expand access to artificial-intelligence skills and strengthen the country's technology workforce.

articles.title: Global AI Investment Continues To Surge
articles.description: Technology companies continue committing enormous resources to artificial intelligence, including data centres, advanced chips, cloud computing and AI research.

articles.title: AI Skills Become Increasingly Important
articles.description: Governments, universities and technology companies are expanding AI education and training programmes as demand for artificial-intelligence skills grows across industries.

articles.title: Washington Rules Out Extending Iran Ceasefire
articles.description: The United States has ruled out extending the temporary ceasefire with Iran as diplomatic negotiations remain stalled. The decision has increased concerns about renewed military escalation.

articles.title: US Economy Faces New Energy Risks
articles.description: Higher oil prices and geopolitical uncertainty are creating new challenges for the US economy. Investors are watching fuel prices, inflation expectations and government bond yields closely.

articles.title: Global Energy Security Under Pressure
articles.description: The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz has renewed concerns about global energy security. Governments and businesses are assessing alternative supply routes and preparing for possible prolonged disruption.

articles.title: International Diplomacy Faces Major Test
articles.description: Diplomatic efforts involving Iran, the United States and regional governments face a critical test as the temporary ceasefire expires and the risk of further escalation increases.

articles.title: Extreme Weather Remains A Global Threat
articles.description: Wildfires, extreme heat and drought continue affecting communities around the world. Emergency agencies are under pressure to protect populations while governments consider longer-term climate resilience measures.

articles.title: Global Shipping Faces Increasing Uncertainty
articles.description: International shipping companies continue monitoring the Strait of Hormuz and other strategic maritime routes as security concerns threaten normal trade and energy transportation.

articles.title: Today's Big Question
articles.description: 🌍 With the Iran-US crisis threatening global energy supplies, wars continuing in Europe and economic pressure affecting households worldwide, what should world leaders prioritise first: 🕊️ peace, 💰 economic stability, or ⚡ energy security? Tell us your opinion.
